title: Gaussian beam Radon transform for tensor fields in $\mathbb{R}^2$
summary: In this article, we introduce and study a set of generalized Gaussian beam Radon transforms (GbRt) acting on tensor fields in $\mathbb{R}^2$. The operators considered include longitudinal, transverse, mixed GbRts, along with their integral moments. These operators extend the corresponding notions of the classical generalized Radon transforms for tensor fields. We establish reconstruction results for vector and symmetric 2-tensor fields using appropriate combinations of the defined transforms.
